title: Pin the stateDiff continuity reset on stream open/error and the clear on `lagged` with their own tests
outcome: Pin the stateDiff continuity reset on stream open/error and the clear on `lagged` with their own tests
acceptance: Two UI tests each fail if their branch is removed. (1) resetStateDiffContinuity on EventSource open and error: with an alignment pending, an error then an open, then a rejected same-revision unmarked state and an unadmittable stateDiff, expect a second alignment request and a null baseline. (2) The `lagged` handler: from a non-null baseline with an alignment pending, a `lagged` event followed by a stateDiff before the recovery state, expect a second alignment request and a null baseline.
